map.📚 深度解析：印张数量计算: 📚 Deep dive: print sheet count calculation
map.书刊印刷前按总页数与开数估算每册印张，进而算全张用纸量与令数，用于工价与备纸。: Before printing a book or periodical, estimate sheets per copy from total pages and open size, then compute full-sheet paper usage and reams, for pricing and paper preparation.
map.对比单面与双面印刷的用纸差异：双面时每册印张减半，大幅省纸。: Compare paper usage between single-sided and duplex: with duplex, sheets per copy halve, saving substantial paper.
map.在报价中计入加放率（印刷/装订损耗），避免按净数备纸导致补印时缺纸。: Include the spoilage rate (printing/binding loss) in quotes to avoid preparing paper to the net count and running short on reprint.
map.以「总页数 320、16 开、印 2000 册、加放 8%、双面印刷」为例: Take "total pages 320, 16 open, 2,000 copies, 8% spoilage, duplex printing" as an example
map.每册印张=页数/(开数×双面系数)=320/(16×2)=10 印张。全张用纸量: Sheets per copy = pages/(open × duplex factor) = 320/(16×2) = 10 sheets. Full-sheet paper usage = 10×2000×(1+8%) = 21,600 full sheets; reams = 21,600/500 = 43.2 reams (1 ream = 500 full sheets). Switching to single-sided gives 20 sheets per copy and 43,200 full sheets = 86.4 reams, doubling paper use. Here 320 pages divides evenly by 16×2=32 for a whole sheet count; when real page counts do not divide evenly, round up or keep the remainder.
map.印张为什么除以开数和双面系数？: Why divide sheets by open size and the duplex factor?
map.一张全张纸经对折裁切出「开数」个页面；双面印刷正反各印一次，故单册印张=总页数/: One full sheet yields "open" pages after folding and cutting; duplex printing prints both sides, so sheets per copy = total pages/(open×2). For example 16 open duplex gives 32 pages per full sheet, so 320 pages needs 10 full sheets. Single-sided gives only 16 pages per full sheet.
map.印刷用纸计量单位，1 令=500 张全张纸（部分特种纸按 1000 张为 1 令: A paper measurement unit where 1 ream = 500 full sheets (some specialty paper uses 1000 sheets per ream, so confirm the supplier convention). On a quote, ream price × reams gives paper cost, and the spoilage rate covers loss.
